lines.zh: 我走得慢，但每一步都沉。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step is heavy.
The ground dents under my feet.
My shoulders are wider than my head.

lines.zh: 我的拳头垂下来，挨着地面。
lines.en: My fists hang low, brushing the ground.
I twist my neck and the bones crack.
All this bulk makes walking heavy.
I drag my feet. No hurry.
That person up ahead. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我拖着重心，地面轻轻震。
lines.en: I drag my weight; the ground trembles faintly.
The grass flattens where I pass.
My hand could cover your face.
Even the wind goes around me.
I stand there, breathing loudly.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比头还宽，走路要侧身。
lines.en: My shoulders are wider than my head; I turn sideways.
This much time is enough to catch my breath.
Look at me all you want.
I lift my chin and scowl.
This place is really too narrow.
I'm thinking about the next step.
My back aches a little.
I let out a long breath.
The dirt is still trembling.
I don't like to smile.

lines.zh: 你最好别在这时候说话。
lines.en: You'd better not speak just now.
I wipe my face.
Once you finish, I move.
You're thinner than I expected.
Your head reaches only my chest.
Don't look at me like that.
I lower my head; my neck creaks.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，挡不住我。
lines.en: That thing in your hand won't stop me.
I look down at you.
I can see your knees shaking.
I don't need to talk.
Where you're standing is just right.
Your breathing is too shallow.

lines.zh: 巴比迪的印记在我额头上。
lines.en: Babidi's mark is on my forehead.
However far you back off, I keep up.
Your shadow reaches only my waist.
I watch your hands, not your face.
Either move, or don't.
I can afford to wait this long.
Your armor is too small.
I tilt my head and my neck cracks again.

lines.zh: 你居然打中了我这具巨猿身体。
lines.en: You actually hit this Great Ape body.

lines.zh: 额上巴比迪的印记还在发烫。
lines.en: The mark of Babidi on my forehead still burns.

lines.zh: 巨猿的重心，压得泥土下陷。
lines.en: The ape's weight sinks into the dirt.

lines.zh: 你的拳头打进我的肉里。
lines.en: Your fist sank into my flesh.

lines.zh: 刀口只到脂肪，我不觉得疼。
lines.en: The blade stops at fat; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 肉凹下去，又自己鼓回来。
lines.en: The flesh dents, then swells back.
The corner of my mouth split.
Don't think I'll fall.

lines.zh: 鼻息喷在土上，扬起一股灰。
lines.en: My breath hits the dirt and raises dust.

lines.zh: 肩上的肉还在跳，我站直了。
lines.en: The muscle on my shoulder twitches; I straighten.
You're holding up that little thing.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我也不低头。
lines.en: Raise the food high; I still won't stoop.

lines.zh: 这点分量，塞我牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill a gap in my teeth.
That isn't one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我要吃的是能打的东西。
lines.en: What I hunger for is something that fights.
The smell on your hands is too faint.
Move it. Don't block me.
I prefer to grab my own.
Your arm will tire.
Put it down and you may go.

lines.zh: 我这副块头，撞上来你自己疼。
lines.en: Charge me and you'll feel it.
I didn't move at all.
You bounced back.
Don't stand pressed against me.
I'm twice as wide as you.
You made me sway once.

lines.zh: 你的肩骨碰到我的腰带。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my belt.
I push, and you go back.
The path is too narrow to pass.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，声音很闷。
lines.en: You hit my chest with a dull sound.
I don't discuss such things.
My looks don't suit tenderness.
You'd better stop asking.
I only want to grow stronger.
Someone gave me power. That's enough.
I need no one.
This bulk was traded for.
I shake my head and turn away.
My smile is ugly.
Keep those words to yourself.
Give me that chest.
I lift it with one hand.
What you drop is mine.
Iron scraps. Oddly heavy.
Shiny things. Put them away.
I stuff it into my belt.
What is this? I don't know it.
I squeezed it. It didn't break.
Watching won't help you.
I take it. Don't speak.
You, stand still.
I've already found you.
Don't run. You can't outrun me.
I've waited long for this punch.
I smell your energy.
You're in my way. Perfect.
I'm striking first.
Wherever you retreat, I keep up.
I lower my body and charge.
You're out of time.
Just you alone?

lines.zh: 你身上那点气，我看够了。
lines.en: I've seen enough of your ki.
Babidi's toy. Put it down.
I've started walking.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，气在掌心聚成球。
lines.en: I raise my hand; ki gathers into a sphere.

lines.zh: 巴比迪的命令，只有一条。
lines.en: Babidi's order is only one line.
Wherever you run, I can see you.

lines.zh: 巨猿的腿，一步就跨过沟。
lines.en: One ape-leg stride clears the ditch.
Circle all you like. I go straight.
This wall opens with one charge.
Your footsteps are slipping.
I listen to you panting.

lines.zh: 这具身体里，塞着别人的力量。
lines.en: Another's power is stuffed into this body.
Step by step, I close the road.
You're hiding behind a pillar.
That pillar won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我这身子，被打断了也不倒。
lines.en: This body won't fall even when broken.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍在墙上，砖碎了。
lines.en: One palm strike and the bricks break.
I don't need to run fast.
I've trampled this ground flat.
Stop, and I'm there.
Only one path left to you.
When I raise my hand, you should dodge.

lines.zh: 巴比迪给了我新的身体。
lines.en: Babidi gave me this new body.
One fist comes down.
The blow drops you into a crouch.
Your ribs made a sound, didn't they?
I grab your collar.
I hurl you away.
Take the Great Ape Beam.
My palm is bigger than your shield.
You fell back three steps.

lines.zh: 我这身肌肉，是被人给的力量。
lines.en: This muscle was a gift from someone else.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在你胸口，听见了吗。
lines.en: My fist on your chest — did you hear it?

lines.zh: 第二拳砸在你挡住的地方。
lines.en: The second fist lands where you blocked.
You're lying on the ground.
I pin your leg with my knee.
This punch lands on your side.
My charge drives you backward.
I raise my boot and bring it down.

lines.zh: 我从那边的阴影里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the shadow over there.
The ground shook first.
You hear me without looking up.
I'm taller than the doorway.
I roll my neck around.
This area belongs to me.
I smiled. It's ugly.
I raise a hand against the light.
You'd better back up.
I'm here. Don't shout.
Heavy footsteps, aren't they.
I stand in the middle of the road.
There's no exit behind you.
My presence makes the air heavy.
You brought a weapon. Good.
I roll my shoulders loose.
The ceiling here is too low.
I don't like being surrounded.

lines.zh: 火烧在胳膊上，烫得发麻。
lines.en: Fire on my arm burns and numbs it.
A fall? This bulk can take it.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我呛得厉害。
lines.en: Water in my mouth. I'm choking.
The blast ended; my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 一根箭插在肩上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.
A spell binds me. I don't like it.
Hunger is blacking out my sight.
Lightning left my whole body numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No ground in the void. Nothing to grip.
